eyebrow: A credential scoped to one container, not the account
code:
CREATE CREDENTIAL
  [https://brennansqlbackups.blob.core.windows.net/offsite-backups]
WITH IDENTITY = 'SHARED ACCESS SIGNATURE',
SECRET = '<sas-token-value>';

BACKUP DATABASE BrennanERP
TO URL = 'https://brennansqlbackups.blob.core.windows.net/
offsite-backups/BrennanERP_Full.bak'
WITH CREDENTIAL = [...], COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM;
caption: No account-wide key sitting in a credential store -- just this container, with an expiry.
The lesson-10 job, not a second pipeline -- local and off-site, every night.

subtitle: Making sure the HA and backup work actually keeps working.
